summary: Verified Home.tsx / PatientWorkspace / DoctorWorkspace / HospitalOperations refactor: source review confirms no stale profile-sync effect, no nested workspace declarations in Home.tsx, HospitalOperations uses useMemo for queue derivation, vite.config.ts has no console.warn, and backend tests use '==' (not 'is') for literal comparisons. Full backend suite (23 cases, 7 files) passes. Fixed 2 stale pre-refactor browser checks that referenced removed testids (technexa-app -> caresetu-app; hospital-referral-timeline -> ${prefix}-timeline) which were leftovers from an earlier rebrand, not app regressions; all 12 browser checks now pass.

checks.criterion: The reported Home.tsx hook dependency risk is removed without introducing render loops or stale profile state
checks.name: patient-profile-and-bounded-assessment
checks.evidence: Source review: HealthProfileCard/ProfileForm in PatientWorkspace.tsx hold form state via useState(() => profile) with no synchronization useEffect; edit -> save -> profile-saved screenshot confirms persisted location via PUT /api/patient/profile, workspace remains responsive with no console errors.

checks.criterion: PatientWorkspace and DoctorWorkspace are decomposed into focused components without changing established flows
checks.name: symptom-followups-quick-choices-to-guidance
checks.evidence: Quick-choice questions 1-3 answered by tap reach assessment-normal-result guidance ('please consult a doctor'); components live in separate patient/PatientWorkspace.tsx and doctor/DoctorWorkspace.tsx modules per source inspection.

checks.criterion: PatientWorkspace and DoctorWorkspace are decomposed into focused components without changing established flows (doctor lookup + AI review)
checks.name: doctor-authorization-required-lookup
checks.evidence: Lookup disabled without authorization checkbox; after checking authorization box, authorized-patient-summary renders patient data via GET /api/doctor/patient/{id} (200).

checks.criterion: PatientWorkspace and DoctorWorkspace are decomposed into focused components without changing established flows (AI review + referral)
checks.name: doctor-ai-review-override-and-referral
checks.evidence: AI assistance panel shown, doctor override applied, referral sent successfully (POST /api/referrals 2xx) end to end through DoctorWorkspace.tsx.

checks.criterion: Hospital queue computation is memoized and operational behavior remains intact
checks.name: hospital-queue-emergency-priority-and-lifecycle
checks.evidence: HospitalOperations.tsx source: routineReferrals/referralById/emergencyItems all wrap state.referrals/state.emergencies with useMemo. Fresh tscheck referral moved Sent->Accepted->Arrived->Outcome Updated via UI; emergency queue bounding box y < routine queue y confirming priority order; timeline visible via corrected testid `${prefix}-timeline`.

checks.criterion: Nested role/workflow rendering and the stale duplicate HospitalWorkspace are removed from Home.tsx
checks.name: desktop-role-switcher-no-errors
checks.evidence: Home.tsx (101 lines) contains only a small Workspace() selector using if/else (role==='patient'/'doctor'/else hospital) delegating to imported PatientWorkspace/DoctorWorkspace/HospitalOperations; no local component declarations for any workspace remain. Switching patient->doctor->hospital roles renders each workspace with zero layout overflow and zero 4xx/5xx responses (testid updated from stale technexa-app to current caresetu-app).

checks.criterion: Production frontend code contains no console.warn and runs without console/request errors
checks.name: branding-caresetu-no-technexa
checks.evidence: grep for console.warn in vite.config.ts returns no matches. Full patient journey (branding check) captured with zero console errors; header/title render correctly.

checks.criterion: Reported Python test anti-patterns and complexity are corrected
checks.name: backend-suite-full
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -> '23 passed in 1.52s' across test_tscheck_branding_caresetu.py, test_tscheck_doctor_access.py, test_tscheck_doctor_referral.py, test_tscheck_document_flow.py, test_tscheck_hospital_queue.py, test_tscheck_patient_assessment.py, test_tscheck_sos_flow.py. grep confirms no literal 'is True'/'is False'/'is "..."' comparisons anywhere in tests (only '==' equality is used); assessment/SOS/referral flows are already split across dedicated files with shared conftest.py fixtures.
